And whereas, the copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public on the 10 December 2025; And whereas objections received from the public for acquisition of right of user for the said pipeline had been considered and disposed by the Competent Authority: And whereas the Competent Authority has under sub-section (1) of section (6) of the said Act, submitted report to the Central Government for acquisition of Right of User in lands appended to the Schedule; And whereas the Central Government, after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said land is required for the pipeline laid, has decided to acquire the right of user therein; Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 6 of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule, appended to this notification, are hereby acquired; vuqlwph eaMy@rglhy@rkyqdk % dtZr ftyk % jk;xM jkT; % egkjk"Vª xk¡o dk uke losZ la@lc fMfotu la vkj-vks-;w- vftZr djus ds fy, {ks=Qy gsDVs;j ,;j fl&,;j 1 2 3 4 5 1½ xkSGokMh 25@18 00 17 00 -- 2 of 3 -- [भाग II—खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण 3 And, further, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4) of section 6 of the said Act, the Central Government hereby directs that the right of user in the said land shall instead of vesting in the Government of India, vest, on the date of the publication of the declaration, in M/s Reliance Gas Transportation Infrastructure Limited, now known as Pipeline Infrastructure Limited, free from encumbrances.
